questions.question: Against what does Ezekiel prophesy in chapter 6?
options: The great rivers of Babylon and all of their many cities
The mountains of Israel and their high places of idolatry
The false prophets who had so long misled all of the people
The temple priests who had grown utterly corrupt over time
questions.answer: The mountains of Israel and their high places of idolatry

questions.question: What recurring purpose statement appears in Ezekiel 6?
options: 'Then you will rebuild what was thrown down'
'Then you shall know that I am the LORD'
'Then you shall rule over many nations'
'Then your land will prosper once again'
questions.answer: 'Then you shall know that I am the LORD'
